seo.title: About - NexusContent Example
seo.description: How NexusContent keeps content and application code separate.

hero.heading: About this site
hero.intro: A reference consumer that proves the Core works beyond Astro: same content, same components, two languages.

richTextContent.content: This example is localised: routes are locale-prefixed and each page is resolved through the locale fallback chain configured in NexusContent. The English and French variants live next to each other in the content repository.
